```{.r .cell-code}
# Convert to a spatial sf object using WGS84 projection (EPSG:4326)
nsw_gliders_sf <- st_as_sf(nsw_gliders, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4283)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Extract elevation data (returns an sf object with an 'elevation' column)
nsw_gliders_elevation_data <- get_elev_point(nsw_gliders_sf, src = "aws")
```
